THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

This appeal, filed under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, challenges the judgment and award dated August 9, 2019, passed by the IX Additional Small Causes and Additional MACT, Bangalore (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal') in MVC No.6320/2018.

entities.text: IX Additional Small Causes and Additional MACT, Bangalore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The claimant, having sustained injuries in an accident, filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Indian Motor Vehicle Act.

The Tribunal awarded a global compensation amount of Rs.40,000/-
along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of the petition until the realization of the entire amount.
The claimant is now before this Court seeking an enhancement of the said award.
3. The learned counsel for the appellant and the learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company have both been heard.
4. The fact that the claimant sustained injuries in a road traffic accident on July 12, 2018, is not disputed.

Due to the NC: 2024:KHC:21250 accident, the claimant sustained abrasions over the right temporal and zygomatic region, a lacerated wound over the lower third of the anterior aspect of the leg, swelling over the left wrist joint, and a fracture of the lower end of the left radius, which is evident from the wound certificate marked as Exhibit P.5.
However, the claimant did not choose to examine a doctor to assess permanent disability and also did not produce a discharge summary.
The Tribunal awarded a global compensation of Rs.40,000/-, which, in my view, is on the lower side considering the nature of the injuries sustained.

Accordingly, I pass the following :
ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed in part.

ii. The impugned judgment and award dated 09.08.2019 passed by the IX Additional Small Causes and Additional MACT.,
Bangalore is hereby modified.
